question: In March 2024, who among the following was elected as the Paralympic Committee of India (PCI) President?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia**, a celebrated Indian para-athlete, was elected as the **President of the Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)** in **March 2024**.
 
• He is a two-time **Paralympic gold medalist** in the javelin throw and is regarded as one of India's most successful para-athletes.
 
• His appointment as the PCI President reflects his commitment to promoting and advancing para-sports in India.
 
• The **Paralympic Committee of India** is the apex body responsible for selecting athletes and organizing their participation in international Paralympic events.
 
• Jhajharia’s leadership is expected to bring significant reforms and growth to the para-sports ecosystem in India, leveraging his extensive experience as an athlete.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Devendra Jhajharia:**

 
 
• He is the first Indian Paralympian to win **two gold medals** at the Paralympic Games (2004 Athens and 2016 Rio).
 
• Born on **10 June 1981** in Rajasthan, he lost his left hand at the age of eight after coming into contact with a live wire.
 
• His achievements include multiple awards such as the **Padma Bhushan** (2022), **Padma Shri** (2012), and **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** (now known as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award).
 
• He holds the **world record** in the F46 javelin throw category, with a throw of 63.97 meters.
 
 
 
• **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI):**
 
 
• The PCI is the **National Paralympic Committee** for India, affiliated with the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• Its primary role is to promote para-sports, organize national championships, and facilitate the participation of Indian athletes in international events, including the Paralympic Games.
 
• The PCI plays a crucial role in ensuring inclusivity and equal opportunities for athletes with disabilities.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Para-athletes:**
 
 
• **Anil Kumar Prakash:** Known for his contributions to Indian athletics, but not associated with para-sports or PCI leadership.
 
• **Sundar Singh Gurjar:** A javelin thrower who won bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics, but not involved in PCI leadership.
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu:** A Paralympic high jumper and gold medalist at Rio 2016, but not the PCI President.
 
 
 
• **India’s Achievements in Paralympics:**
 
 
• India has seen tremendous success in the Paralympics, with athletes excelling in events like javelin throw, high jump, and shooting.
 
• At the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics**, India won a total of **19 medals**, including 5 gold, 8 silver, and 6 bronze, making it the country's best performance to date.
 
• The success of athletes like Devendra Jhajharia, Mariyappan Thangavelu, and Avani Lekhara has inspired a new generation of para-athletes in India.
